name: Barbell Bench Press
description: A classic upper-body compound exercise that builds strength and muscle in the chest and triceps.
instructions: Lie flat on the bench with your feet firmly on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar slowly toward your chest.
Press the bar upward until your arms are extended.

name: Barbell Squat
description: A powerful lower-body compound exercise targeting the legs and glutes.
instructions: Place the bar securely across your upper back.
Stand with your feet around shoulder width apart.
Lower your hips while keeping your chest lifted.
Drive through your feet to return to the starting position.

name: Deadlift
description: A full-body strength exercise focused on the posterior chain.
instructions: Stand with your feet under the bar.
Bend your knees and grip the bar firmly.
Keep your back neutral as you lift the bar.
Stand tall and lower the bar with control.

name: Pull Up
description: A bodyweight exercise that develops the back and arm muscles.
instructions: Grip the bar with your palms facing away.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower yourself slowly to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: A shoulder-focused pressing exercise for building upper-body strength.
instructions: Sit upright with a dumbbell in each hand.
Start with the dumbbells near shoulder height.
Press both dumbbells overhead.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder level.

name: Barbell Row
description: A compound pulling exercise that strengthens the upper and middle back.
instructions: Hold the bar with a comfortable overhand grip.
Hinge forward while keeping your back neutral.
Pull the bar toward your lower chest.
Lower the bar slowly and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Curl
description: A simple isolation exercise for developing the biceps.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly without swinging.

name: Tricep Pushdown
description: An isolation exercise designed to strengthen and develop the triceps.
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine.
Grip the handle with both hands.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Push the handle down and slowly return.

name: Leg Press
description: A machine-based lower-body exercise targeting the legs and glutes.
instructions: Sit securely in the leg press machine.
Place your feet shoulder width apart on the platform.
Lower the platform with controlled movement.
Push the platform back without locking your knees.

name: Lateral Raise
description: A shoulder isolation exercise that focuses on the lateral deltoids.
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms until they are around shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbells slowly.

name: Plank
description: A bodyweight core exercise that improves stability and endurance.
instructions: Start in a forearm plank position.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Brace your core throughout the hold.
Maintain the position for the planned duration.

name: Dumbbell Lunge
description: A unilateral leg exercise that develops strength, balance, and coordination.
instructions: Stand tall while holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step forward with one leg.
Lower your body until both knees are bent.
Push through the front foot and return to standing.
